skills.name: Triple Slash

hits.label: Strike 1
hits.description:
A constant pattern of 3 distinct strikes, each dealing 12 (0 + 130% Melee Attack) Physical Damage and inflicting different effects.
Attack 1: Shakes enemy for 3s.
Attack 2: Deals additional damage to Tripped enemies.
Attack 3: Increases Melee damage +30% and hits multiple enemies in front of you.
Hold down for continuous use.

skills.name: Whirlwind Slash

hits.label: Strike 1
hits.description:
A spinning attack with up to 3 distinct strikes, each dealing 527 (518 + 100% Melee Attack) Physical Damage to many nearby enemies.
Attack 1: Deals additional damage to Shaken targets, and Trips Slowed targets
Attack 2: Deals additional damage to Tripped targets.
Attack 3: Knocks back nearby enemies.
This skill counts as a Push effect.
No cooldown between strikes. Hold down for continuous use.

skills.name: Sunder Earth
skills.description:
Smashes open a fault line in front of you, dealing 318 (288 + 300% Melee Attack) Physical damage to all enemies in its path and decreasing their Move Speed -60% for 3s.
All allies in the area of effect gain Earth Energy, decreasing received damage -30% for up to 7 seconds.

skills.name: Swordfall
skills.description:
Call down swords from the sky to Impale enemies in front of you, dealing up to 1684 (1613 + 680% Melee Attack) Physical Damage. Use this skill again to stop channeling early. The longer you channel, the more damage will be dealt. 
If cast while at 6 Abyssal Charges, additional swords are summoned, inflicting more damage the closer an enemy is to the center of the effect.
